SituationLine.description: One sentence of facts from your own senses: sun, light, shelter, creatures closing, health, hunger. Absent when nothing is known.

LookInput.description: Look around: returns a snapshot of your surroundings and the text written nearby.

WaitInput.description: Wait until something worth a decision happens, or max_seconds pass. Pass the cursor from the last result to see events you have not seen. A recipe or notable-block list the same as in your last wait comes back as {"unchanged": true, "count": n}; `look` returns it in full.

interests.description: Event kinds that may end the wait. Default: all of them.

peek.description: Read-only wait: returns events after the cursor without marking them as seen.

ActInput.description: Act: say, up to 6 actions, or set intent. Needs intent, actions or say. An intent must carry limits. Minimal valid intent: {"goal":"gather_oak_log","program":"gather","arguments":{"block":"oak_log","count":12},"wake_on":["goal_completed"],"limits":{"max_world_ticks":2400,"max_block_operations":64}}

reasoning.description: Private reasoning, <= 80 words. Never shown to other agents.

say.description: What to say aloud, or null.

intent.description: The durable thing to pursue. Replaces the current intent. To put up a structure use program build with arguments {blueprint: shelter, wall or pillar; block: one exact item id you carry, such as oak_planks, not planks}. A shelter takes 25 blocks of that one kind, a wall 15, a pillar 3. Free-form build actions are not available. Other programs: explore walks up to `legs` (1–12) legs of `leg_blocks` (8–48) blocks each toward chunks you have not visited, avoiding water while `avoid_water` is true, and stops when nothing new is near or danger is close. farm harvests ripe crops within `radius` (4–24) blocks, at most `max_cells` (1–32), and replants when `replant` is true; it never touches a crop that is not yours, and never tills. patrol walks a `route` of 2 to 8 block positions {x, y, z} `laps` (1–5) times, back to the start when `loop` is true.

actions.description: Immediate steps, at most 6, executed in order. Verbs (do): goto, mine, craft, place, attack, eat, sleep, unstick (get free when stuck; needs no blocks), give, write_sign, write_book, read_book, use_skill, define_skill, offer, propose, vote, note, wait, open, deposit, withdraw, till, edit_sign, use.

SayInput.description: Say something aloud to those nearby.
